channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Cloudflare Details Its Migration from WordPress to EmDash
item.description: Cloudflare recently documented the migration of its main blog from WordPress to EmDash, the open source content management system developed internally. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Transcribe adds customer-managed KMS keys for custom resources
item.description: Amazon Transcribe now lets you encrypt your custom vocabularies, custom vocabulary filters, and custom language models at rest with a customer-managed AWS KMS key that you own and control. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 R8i and R8i-flex instances are now available in additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R8i and R8i-flex instances are available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 C8i and C8i-flex instances are now available in additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C8i and C8i-flex instances are available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS IAM outbound identity federation now supports interface VPC endpoints for OIDC discovery
item.description: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) outbound identity federation now supports Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) endpoints for the OpenID Connect (OIDC) discovery APIs. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS DataSync launches a monitoring dashboard for tracking task executions across your account
item.description: AWS DataSync now provides a monitoring dashboard in the DataSync console that gives you visibility into your data transfers across your account. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Stateless MCP Removes Session Affinity Requirements for AWS Server Deployments
item.description: AWS details how the latest Model Context Protocol specification removes protocol-level sessions, sticky-session requirements, and session storage for remote MCP servers. (1 source: infoq)
